Chapter 6538: Who Are You?

Chapter 6538: Who Are You?

However, it stood up again with the same oppressive momentum. The hole in the scales revealed its tough body that had been refined countless times, stronger and shinier than any armor.

“What are you? Certainly not alive.” A cultivator appeared before the creature and stared curiously at it.

He was a youth in black; his medium-length hair was tied up like a spear ready to pierce the sky. He was handsome with big, round black eyes. It looked divine and unique.

His demeanor differed from other masters. He had no shackles and worried not about mundane conventions. His hair always attracted attention.

“Supreme Black Ancestor!” A primal ancestor recognized him and prostrated in reverence.

“Supreme Black Ancestor?!” Listeners were struck by lightning.

The name had the same prestige as Xian Chengtian since he was among the few supreme overlords in Three Immortals.

Rumor has it he was already in this realm long ago and acted as Desolate Ancestor’s protector. Some said he might be the founder of Life and Death Heaven.

Regardless of his history, he has participated in all the major wars until now and left his marks on the river of time.

He rarely appeared after Nightwatch so the juniors never had the privilege of being in his presence. They thought he would be an imperious being forcing others to prostrate.

However, his actual appearance said otherwise. He looked more like a young master from a rich clan, always driving his seniors crazy until he was kicked out of the house.

“Huh...” They stared at him in astonishment.

Of course, despite his appearance, he was a real supreme overlord with enough power to destroy the world. Spectators kept their thoughts to themselves and didn’t comment.

Only the primal ancestors and heaven-slayers recognized his greatness. He didn’t need to prove himself to the others; his battle record alone said it all. Moreover, the lucky survivors saw him in action during the immortal wars. They willingly prostrated to show respect.

This caused a chain reaction since the juniors had to do the same after seeing their ancestors kneeling.

Meanwhile, the dragon hybrid didn’t answer, seemingly without intelligence.

“How did Bao Pu create you?” Supreme Black Ancestor could see that the creature was alive.

However, it was one of a kind. Nothing like it existed in Three Immortals. Therefore, Bao Pu must have created it using an unknown method.

“Raa!” It roared in response and raised its weapon again. The immortal flame surged from its body into the weapon. It could destroy all of Heaven World if left unchecked.

The crowd was used to its power for now so they were scared out of their mind. It could seep out of Corpse Wasteland and kill them all.

“Definitely at the overlord level.” A primal ancestor commented.

Bao Pu was nowhere to be found yet the first guard turned out to be an overlord.

Nevertheless, Supreme Black Ancestor raised both hands in the air. With a black glow around them, he seemed to be lifting all of Three Immortals and easily parrying the attack.

“A regular body, refined by immortal power or not, can’t handle this influx.” He was still surprised to see the dragon hybrid’s potential.

“Raa!” Another roar came as a response.

“How interesting.” He said. Only a few cultivators in Three Immortals could have endured this power.

They had to be famous as well, so he wanted to figure out the creature’s identity.

He slowly pushed the halberd up until it was above the dragon hybrid’s head before pushing it back down against the creature.

The process was simple but Heaven World seemed to be sinking with it.
